fixture: 96 configured stocks, 24 active internal indices divisible by 4 in ChannelNo 1; 60 closed tick batches, 1440 tick samples, 61 BatchEnd markers including opening; synthetic wire data and actual deployed tick model weights
method: One unthrottled replay per configuration, timed from first ingress through finish/drain. Model load and fixture generation excluded. Not live latency, not one-batch latency, not NIC reception timing.
limitations: ChannelNo distribution and per-stock activity are synthetic and deliberately expose modulo routing skew.
Inputs are submitted without market pacing, intentionally creating a backlog; P99 reflects that backlog.
Histogram percentiles are bucket upper bounds; small run-to-run scheduling variation is expected.
Snapshot-first owners are pinned before ChannelNo is known and cannot guarantee later per-channel count balance.
Production processes and profiles were not restarted or replaced.
